claims.statement: The Northgate Business Park lease imposes a controllable-expense cap of 5% per annum, applied cumulatively and on a compounding basis, on the tenant's reimbursement obligation for operating expenses.

citations.quote: Tenant reimburses its pro rata share of operating expenses and real estate taxes on a triple-net basis, subject to a controllable-expense cap of 5% per annum on a cumulative, compounding basis.
